new_packages.label: מַלְכוּת הָרְשָׁעָה וְגַדְלוּת — הַגָּלוּת
new_packages.label_en: The Wicked Kingdom and Arrogance — Exile
new_packages.reason: This is the evil mirror of Package 1 (the holy Shekhinah/Malkhut). The Rebbe explicitly states: 'גדלות היא ממלכות הרשעה, שרוצה להתגדל ולמלוך' — arrogance/pride IS from the wicked kingdom. This is the same bechina structure as the holy side: מלכות הרשעה = גדלות = מחשבות של גדלות = גאוה. The wicked kingdom has the same structure as the holy kingdom — it is a 'kingdom that wants to rule' — but oriented toward evil rather than holiness. Just as the holy מלכות IS תפלה IS אני, the evil מלכות IS גדלות IS גאוה. This package is entirely absent from the bechina dataset but is robustly supported by the source text.

source_evidence.quote: גַּדְלוּת הִיא מִמַּלְכוּת הָרְשָׁעָה, שֶׁרוֹצָה לְהִתְגַּדֵּל וְלִמְלֹךְ

כִּי הַתְּפִלָּה, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת מַלְכוּת, בְּחִינַת אֲנִי, הִיא בַּגָּלוּת בְּתוֹךְ מַלְכוּת הָרְשָׁעָה... וּכְשֶׁהִיא רוֹצָה לָצֵאת, אֲזַי מִתְאַחֶזֶת בָּהּ מַלְכוּת הָרְשָׁעָה, הַיְנוּ גַּדְלוּת
כַּד הַגַּאֲוָה, הַיְנוּ מַלְכוּת הָרְשָׁעָה, גּוֹבֶרֶת עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל

observations:
Torah 84 is a short but structurally rich teaching centered on one binary opposition: the holy Shekhinah (= תפלה = מלכות = אני = אלקים) versus the wicked kingdom (= מלכות הרשעה = גדלות = גאוה). The bechina dataset for this Torah captured only one side of the mirror — the good package (Package 1). The evil side is present in the source text with explicit bechina language but was not encoded as bechina edges.

The case for a new evil-mirror package (Package 2) rests on three explicit bechina statements in the source text:

1. 'גדלות היא ממלכות הרשעה' — arrogance IS the wicked kingdom (direct equivalence)
2. 'אזי מתאחזת בה מלכות הרשעה, הינו גדלות' — the wicked kingdom, NAMELY arrogance (the Rebbe's 'הינו' = equivalence marker)
3. 'כד הגאוה, הינו מלכות הרשעה' — pride, NAMELY the wicked kingdom

These three statements connect גדלות, גאוה, and מלכות הרשעה as bechinas of each other. The pattern mirrors exactly what the Rebbe does on the good side ('תפלה, הינו בחינת מלכות, בחינת אני'). The evil package has the same structure: multiple names for the same essential evil reality — the force of self-aggrandizement that grabs the Shekhinah when she tries to emerge from exile.

Note on the 3-node threshold: the spec asks for '3+ concepts connected by explicit bechina language forming an independent domain.' The evil package has at least 3: מלכות הרשעה, גדלות, גאוה — all equated as the same thing by the Rebbe's explicit 'הינו' formula. This meets the threshold for a new package proposal.

Note on what is NOT a new package:
- 'קן' (nest) and 'כסויין' (coverings): These are linguistic puns (לשון קן, לשון כסויין) used to interpret the word 'נכסין,' but the Rebbe does not build a bechina cluster around them. They serve as word-play evidence for the main concept (the Shekhinah being extracted from her coverings), not as an independent domain.
- 'שבועה / שבעה / אבות': These are rich bechinas (the Shekhinah's restored garments = patriarchs; she = oath/seven) but they function as the culminating state of Package 1 rather than an independent domain. They belong in Package 1 as missing additions, not as a new package.
- 'תפלה בכח' (forceful prayer): The Rebbe calls this the means/eitza for strengthening the Shekhinah. It appears in the dataset as an eitza node (cause → effect). It does not generate its own bechina cluster — it is the mechanism, not an independent domain.
